script: In 1974, humans beamed a picture message toward the stars. It was sent from the giant Arecibo radio telescope in Puerto Rico. The message was just 1,679 bits long, forming a simple picture. It showed numbers, DNA, a human figure and our solar system. It was aimed at a star cluster called M13, roughly 25,000 light-years away. The Arecibo telescope itself collapsed in 2020.
